newsitem.title: USA: USABancShares says files to extend stock.
newsitem.headline: USABancShares says files to extend stock.

text.p: USABancshares said on Tuesday it filed an application with the Federal Reserve seeking approval to extend its stock ownership in Regent Bancshares Corp beyond five percent.
USABancShares also said it had hired investment banking firm Ryan, Beck & Co to serve as its financial adviser.
Ryan, Beck & Co would assist in evaluating strategic alternatives and capital raising opportunities which could relate to further investment in Regent, it said.

"Ryan, Beck specializes in bank mergers & acquisitions, and has a fantastic record of success in structuring and funding important transactions," Kenneth Tepper, president and chief executive officer, said.
